elements.name: Frederick Augustus I of Saxony Monument

osmTags.inscription: Friedrich August dem Gerechten das dankbare Vaterland. Denn ewiglich wird er nicht wanken, der Nachruhm des Gerechten bleibt ewig.
Hier wirkte Kaplan Alojs Andritzki Jg. 1914 verhaftet 1941 Dachau ermordet 3.2.1943
Hier arbeitete Max Hermann Dietze JG. 1901 Zeuge Jehovas Verhaftet 1933 Hohenstein 1935 Sachsenhausen Tot an Haftfolgen 28.9.1938
Hier arbeitete Ernst Fritz Gottschling JG. 1903 Zeuge Jehovas Verhaftet 1937 Buchenwald Todesmarsch Ermordet 21.4.1945

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.
